Employee Benefits — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Health Insurance
All permanent employees receive private health insurance from their first day, covering the employee and their immediate dependents. Coverage includes consultations, hospitalization, and prescription medication.

Employee Benefits — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Professional Development
Each employee has an annual **learning budget of 5,000 MAD** for courses, certifications, and conferences relevant to their role. Requests are approved by the direct manager. HR-Genius Technologies also sponsors one internal "Learning Day" per quarter.

Employee Benefits — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Meal & Transport
Employees receive meal vouchers for each in-office day and a monthly transport allowance. Remote days are not eligible for meal vouchers.

Employee Benefits — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Wellbeing
The company offers an Employee Assistance Programme with confidential counselling, plus subsidized gym membership. Two "wellbeing days" per year may be taken with no reason required, separate from annual and sick leave.

Employee Benefits — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Referral Bonus
Employees who refer a candidate that is hired and passes probation receive a referral bonus of 6,000 MAD.

Code of Conduct — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Our Standards
Everyone at HR-Genius Technologies is expected to act with integrity, respect, and professionalism. We are committed to an inclusive workplace free of discrimination and harassment of any kind, based on gender, religion, origin, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

Code of Conduct — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Anti-Harassment
Harassment, bullying, and retaliation are strictly prohibited. Concerns can be raised confidentially with the Human Resources Department or through the anonymous reporting channel on the HR-Genius platform. All reports are investigated promptly and treated confidentially.

Code of Conduct — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Conflicts of Interest
Employees must disclose any personal, financial, or family interest that could conflict with their duties. Accepting gifts of significant value from clients or suppliers is not permitted.

Code of Conduct — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Confidentiality
Company, client, and employee information must be kept confidential and used only for legitimate business purposes, during and after employment.

Code of Conduct — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Disciplinary Process
Breaches of this code are handled through a progressive process: informal discussion, written warning, final written warning, and, for serious cases, termination. Serious misconduct may lead to immediate dismissal.

IT & Security Policy — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Accounts & Passwords
Every employee receives company accounts on their first day. Passwords must be at least 12 characters and are rotated every 6 months. Multi-factor authentication is required for all company systems. Never share credentials.

IT & Security Policy — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Acceptable Use
Company devices and accounts are for work purposes. Limited personal use is tolerated but must not interfere with duties or breach the law. Installing unapproved software is not permitted.

IT & Security Policy — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Data Protection
HR-Genius Technologies handles personal data in line with applicable data-protection law. Employee and client data must only be accessed on a need-to-know basis. Data must not be copied to personal devices or unapproved cloud services.

IT & Security Policy — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Device Security
Laptops must have disk encryption and an auto-lock of 5 minutes enabled. Lost or stolen devices must be reported to IT immediately. Company data on personal phones must be protected by a passcode.

IT & Security Policy — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Incident Reporting
Suspected security incidents, phishing, or data breaches must be reported to the IT team within 24 hours through the HR-Genius platform or the IT helpdesk.

Leave & Time-Off Policy — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Annual Leave
Every full-time employee at HR-Genius Technologies is entitled to **20 paid annual leave days per calendar year**. Leave accrues monthly and unused days may be carried over up to a maximum of 5 days into the following year. Carried-over days expire on 31 March.

Annual leave must be requested through the HR-Genius platform at least **7 calendar days in advance** for absences of 3 days or more. Requests are reviewed by the employee's direct manager and then confirmed by the Human Resources Department.

Leave & Time-Off Policy — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Sick Leave
Employees are entitled to **12 paid sick days per year**. A medical certificate is required for any sick absence longer than 2 consecutive days. Sick leave does not count against the annual leave balance.

Leave & Time-Off Policy — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Unpaid Leave
Unpaid leave may be granted at management discretion for personal circumstances once annual leave is exhausted. Unpaid leave does not accrue benefits and must be approved by both the direct manager and HR.

Leave & Time-Off Policy — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Public Holidays
HR-Genius Technologies observes all official public holidays in Morocco. When a public holiday falls on a weekend, no substitute day is granted.

Leave & Time-Off Policy — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Parental Leave
Maternity leave is 14 weeks of paid leave. Paternity leave is 3 paid days, to be taken within one month of the birth.

Probation & Performance — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Probation Period
New employees serve a **probation period of 3 months**. During probation, either party may end the employment with 7 days' notice. A probation review meeting is held before the end of the period to confirm the permanent role.

Probation & Performance — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Performance Reviews
Formal performance reviews occur **twice a year** (June and December). Reviews assess objectives, competencies, and development goals agreed with the manager. Outcomes inform salary reviews and promotions.

Probation & Performance — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Promotions
Promotions are based on sustained performance, readiness for greater responsibility, and business need. A promotion is documented with an official letter issued by the Human Resources Department and may include a salary adjustment.

Probation & Performance — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Notice Periods
After probation, the standard notice period is **1 month** for most roles and **2 months** for senior and management roles, unless the employment contract states otherwise.

Probation & Performance — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Resignation
Resignations should be submitted in writing to the direct manager and the Human Resources Department. HR will arrange an exit interview and return of company equipment.

Remote & Hybrid Work Policy — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Hybrid Model
HR-Genius Technologies operates a **hybrid work model**. Employees are expected to work from the Casablanca office at **12 Innovation Avenue** for a minimum of **3 days per week**, with up to 2 days of remote work permitted. Teams may agree on fixed in-office "anchor days" to support collaboration.

chunks.source: Remote & Hybrid Work Policy — HR-Genius Technologies
chunks.text:
Remote & Hybrid Work Policy — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Full Remote
Fully remote arrangements are considered case by case and require approval from the department head and the Human Resources Department. They are reviewed every 6 months.

chunks.source: Remote & Hybrid Work Policy — HR-Genius Technologies

Remote & Hybrid Work Policy — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Expectations
Remote employees must be reachable during **core hours (10:00–16:00)**, keep their calendar up to date, and use company-approved tools for communication and file sharing. Home internet and a suitable workspace are the employee's responsibility; a one-time home-office stipend of 2,000 MAD is available on request.

Remote & Hybrid Work Policy — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Equipment
Company laptops may be used at home. Equipment remains the property of HR-Genius Technologies and must be returned upon leaving the company.

Working Hours & Payroll — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Working Hours
Standard working hours are **40 hours per week**, Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 18:00 with a one-hour lunch break. Core collaboration hours are 10:00–16:00. Flexible start times between 08:00 and 10:00 are permitted with manager agreement.

Working Hours & Payroll — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Overtime
Overtime must be pre-approved by a manager. Approved overtime is compensated as time off in lieu at a rate of 1.25 hours per overtime hour worked.

Working Hours & Payroll — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Payroll Schedule
Salaries are paid **monthly, on the 27th of each month**. If the 27th falls on a weekend or public holiday, payment is made on the last preceding working day. Payslips are issued through the HR-Genius platform.

Working Hours & Payroll — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Salary Reviews
Formal salary reviews take place once per year, in January, and are based on performance and market benchmarks. Off-cycle adjustments require Human Resources Department and department-head approval.

Working Hours & Payroll — HR-Genius Technologies — ## Expense Reimbursement
Work-related expenses are reimbursed within 15 working days of an approved claim. Claims must include a receipt and be submitted within 30 days of the expense.
